script.title: NO HEAT IN JANUARY
script.scene_zh: 冬日公寓 · 報修暖氣
script.story_hook: The heat died overnight. Today we call maintenance.
script.intro_zh: 暖氣半夜罷工，今天打電話報修。
script.welcome_en: Today's call is about a broken heater. Bring a blanket!
script.welcome_zh: 今天的對話是報修暖氣。記得帶條毯子！
script.outro: Now you know how to report a broken heater. Stay warm!
script.outro_zh: 你已經會用英文報修暖氣了。注意保暖！
script.practice_intro_en: Let's practice the phone repair phrases together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 一起來跟讀電話報修的句型。
script.char_a_description: a petite young woman in her early twenties with copper-red hair in a messy bun, round glasses, an olive green sweater, plaid pajama pants, and thick fluffy socks
script.char_b_description: a heavyset man in his forties with close-cropped black hair and a short trimmed beard, wearing a navy maintenance polo with a name patch, cargo pants, and steel-toe work boots

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, maintenance? This is Dana in 3C.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ məˈntɛnəns ðɪs ɪz ˈdeɪnə ɪn ˈθriˈsi/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，是維修部嗎？我是3C的Dana。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning, Dana. What seems to be wrong?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈdinə wʌt simz tə bi rɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 早安，Dana。怎麼了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My heater's dead. The apartment is freezing.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈhitɚz dɛd ði əˈpɑrtmənt ɪz ˈfrizɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 暖氣完全沒了，公寓冷得像冰庫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no. When did it stop working?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ noʊ wɛn dɪd ɪt stɑp ˈwɜrkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哦不。它是什麼時候停的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sometime overnight. It just blows cold air.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌtaɪm ˈoʊvɚˌnaɪt ɪt dʒʌst bloʊz koʊld ɛr/
dialogue.zh: 半夜某個時候，現在只吹冷風。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is the thermostat set to heat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈθɜrməstæt sɛt tə hit/
dialogue.zh: 恆溫器設在製熱模式了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, all the way up. Nothing happens.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɔl ðeɪ ʌp ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈhæpənz/
dialogue.zh: 設到最高了，一點反應都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, did you try flipping the switch?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ dɪd ju traɪ ˈflɪpɪŋ ðə swɪtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 好，你有去扳開關試過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The switch by the front door?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə swɪtʃ baɪ ðə frʌnt dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 玄關旁邊那個開關嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the one. Twice, nice and slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ði wʌn taɪs naɪs ænd sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 對，就是它。慢慢地關開兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on... yep, I just did.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn jɛp aɪ dʒʌst dɪd/
dialogue.zh: 等一下……好，我剛試了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any hum or clicking now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni hʌm ɔr ˈklɪkɪŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 現在有嗡嗡聲或喀喀聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm... actually, yes! A little clicking.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ˈæktʃuəli jɛs ə ˈlɪtl ˈklɪkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯……真的有！小小的喀喀聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good sign. It might just need a reset.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd saɪn ɪt maɪt dʒʌst nid ə ˈrisɛt/
dialogue.zh: 好現象，可能只要重設。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wait, or will you come?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ weɪt ɔr wɪl ju kʌm/
dialogue.zh: 我要等，還是你會來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can swing by after lunch, maybe two?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn swɪŋ baɪ ˈæftɚ lʌntʃ ˈmeɪbi tu/
dialogue.zh: 我午飯後過去，兩點左右好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two works. I'll be home all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wɜrks aɪl bi hoʊm ɔl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 兩點可以，我今天都在家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Quick question about entry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɚfɪkt kwɪk ˈkwɛstʃən əˈbaʊt ˈɛntri/
dialogue.zh: 完美。快速問一下進門的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You mean coming into my place?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju min ˈkʌmɪŋ ˈintə maɪ pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 你是說進我家裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. Are you okay with us entering?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɑr ju oʊˈkeɪ wɪð ʌs ˈɛntərɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對，你同意我們進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fine, as long as someone knocks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts faɪn æz lɔŋ æz ˈsʌmwʌn nɑks/
dialogue.zh: 可以，只要會先敲門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We always knock first. Rules, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈɔlweɪz nɑk fɚst rulz ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我們一定先敲門，這是規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cat bolts if the door opens.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kæt boʊlts ɪf ðə dɔr ˈoʊpənz/
dialogue.zh: 我養的貓，門一開就會衝出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Keep her in a room, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ kip hɪr ɪn ə rum ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 哈！那就先把她關在房間裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted. What tools do you need to bring?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪd wʌt tulz du ju nid tə brɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。你需要帶什麼工具？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Multimeter, wrench, and a new capacitor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌltɪˌmitɚ rɛntʃ ænd ə nuː kəˈpæsɪtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 電表、扳手，還有一顆新電容器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That word. Can you spell it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɜrd kæn ju spɛl ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那個詞，你能拼一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: C-a-p-a-c-i-t-o-r. It starts the motor.
dialogue.phonetic: /si eɪ pi eɪ si aɪ ti oʊ ɑr ɪt stɑrtz ðə ˈmoʊtɚ/
dialogue.zh: C-a-p-a-c-i-t-o-r，它負責啟動馬達。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, so like a jump start?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ soʊ laɪk ə dʒʌmp stɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 哦，就像幫汽車接電啟動那樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly like jump-starting a car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli laɪk dʒʌmp ˈstɑrtɪŋ ə kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 一模一樣，就是跳標啟動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool. Um, is this an emergency?
dialogue.phonetic: /kul ʌm ɪz ðɪs æn iˈmɜrdʒənsi/
dialogue.zh: 了解。呃，這算緊急事故嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No heat in January? Absolutely it is.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ hit ɪn ˈdʒænjuˌɛri ˈæbsəˌlutli ɪt ɪz/
dialogue.zh: 一月沒暖氣？當然算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I use my space heater?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ juz maɪ speɪs ˈhitɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我可以先用電暖爐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but keep it off the curtains.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt kip ɪt ɔf ðə ˈkɜrtənz/
dialogue.zh: 可以，但離窗簾遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good tip. Big blanket night, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tɪp bɪɡ ˈblæŋkɪt naɪt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 好建議。看來今晚要靠大毯子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Layer up. Cold floors, thick socks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪər ʌp koʊld flɔrz θɪk sɑks/
dialogue.zh: 多穿幾層，地板涼就穿厚襪子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pipes worry me when it's this cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə paɪps ˈwɜri mi wɛn ɪts ðɪs koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 這麼冷我擔心水管會凍裂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave the cabinet doors open tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ðə ˈkæbənɪt dɔrz ˈoʊpən təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚把櫥櫃門開著別關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under the sink? Won't that look messy?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndɚ ðə sɪŋk woʊnt ðæt lʊk ˈmɛsi/
dialogue.zh: 水槽下面？那樣不會很亂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Messy beats a burst pipe, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛsi bits ə bɜrst paɪp trʌst mi/
dialogue.zh: 亂總比水管爆裂好，相信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True. Let's do that, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru lɛts du ðæt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 說得是，那就照辦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also, I'll check your neighbors' heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ aɪl tʃɛk jɔr ˈneɪbɚz hit/
dialogue.zh: 另外，我也會順道檢查鄰居的暖氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why? Does 3B have the same problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dʌz ˈθriˈbi hæv ðə seɪm ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼？3B也有一樣的問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes a whole row goes same week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ə hoʊl roʊ ɡoʊz seɪm wik/
dialogue.zh: 有時整排房同週一起壞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, the building is pretty old, huh.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ ɪz ˈprɪti oʊld hʌ/
dialogue.zh: 哇，這棟大樓還真有點年紀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ninety years young. Character with aches.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnti jɪrz jʌŋ ˈkærəktɚ wɪð eɪks/
dialogue.zh: 九十大壽啦。有韻味，也有毛病。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like its character, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ɪts ˈkærəktɚ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我喜歡這棟樓的韻味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's kind. I'll text when I'm out front.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts kaɪnd aɪl tɛkst wɛn aɪm aʊt frʌnt/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。我到門口會傳訊息給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Can I text you instead of calling?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt kæn aɪ tɛkst ju ɪnˈstɛd əv ˈkɔlɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好。以後我能傳訊給你，不用打電話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure. Ask for Lou, that's me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr æsk fɚ laʊ ðæts mi/
dialogue.zh: 當然，找Lou就行，那就是我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lou, thanks so much. You sound calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /laʊ θæŋks soʊ mʌtʃ ju saʊnd kɑm/
dialogue.zh: Lou，太謝謝你了。你聽起來好穩重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Panic doubles repair bills. Never panic.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpænɪk ˈdəbləz rɪˈpɛr bɪlz ˈnɛvɚ ˈpænɪk/
dialogue.zh: 慌張會讓維修費加倍，千萬彆慌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! I'll remember that one.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪl rɪˈmɛmbɚ ðæt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 哈！這句我記住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two o'clock, knock first, cat secured.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu əˈklɑk nɑk fɚst kæt sɪˈkjʊrd/
dialogue.zh: 兩點、先敲門、貓收好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, one more thing. The rent credit?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt wʌn mɔr θɪŋ ðə rɛnt ˈkrɛdɪt/
dialogue.zh: 等等，還有件事。租金可以折抵嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Credits need a form. I'll bring one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkrɛdɪts nid ə fɔrm aɪl brɪŋ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 折抵要填表，我帶一份來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're thinking of everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əv ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 你什麼都想到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Occupational hazard. See you at two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɑkjoʊˈpeɪʃənəl ˈhærdərd si ju ət tu/
dialogue.zh: 職業病啦。兩點見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, Lou. Really.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju laʊ ˈrɪli/
dialogue.zh: 真的謝謝你，Lou。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime. Stay warm till then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnɪˌtaɪm steɪ wɔrm tɪl ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，在此之前記得保暖。

script.youtube_description:
冬天暖氣壞了，怎麽用英文打電話報修？
這一集是60句完整的報修對話：描述故障、電話健檢、進門同意、緊急等級、租金折抵，全部聽得懂。

你會學到：
・ describing a broken heater on the phone（用英文描述暖氣故障）
・ giving permission for entry（同意維修人員進門）
・ asking about rent credits（詢問租金折抵）

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，不用背，多聽就會用。

記得訂閱，寒冷的夜晚用得上！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en:
The heat dies in January. What do you say on the phone? Learn to report a broken heater in English.
This episode is one full 60-line call: symptoms, troubleshooting, entry permission, emergency level, and rent credit.

You will hear:
・ phone English for maintenance requests
・ simple troubleshooting phrases
・ polite small talk under pressure

The second half is line-by-line listening and repeat-after-me practice. No memorizing - just listen, and it sticks.

Subscribe for more real-life English calls and conversations!
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
